positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description: Involved in several projects including web design, e-commerce sites, full-stack development, and acting as a consultant for tech-starters. Some of those projects can be seen in my portfolio and CV.

company.name: The Ksquare Group, Boy Scouts of America & more clients

positions.title: Tech Lead (Contractor)
positions.description:
Leading the technical UI team to deliver a new key-product (Den Leader Experience) for the organization under a tight schedule (11 weeks).
●	Successfully built and delivered a business key-product as an MVP under a tight schedule; development and deployment under less than 9 weeks.
●	Leading role for the Front-End team. Constant follow-up and knowledge transfer in order to get better alignment across teams.
●	Product was delivered as a Progressive Web App (PWA) that included installation handling, caching mechanisms and responsive mode designs.
●	App was React-based, implementing functional components and hooks; Redux for state management, Redux Sagas for async function handling, and a customized Material UI theme for the UI components.
●	Partial project estimation and management; writing using stories, test cases & performing validation of product features.

positions.title: React Developer (Contractor)
positions.description: Support on the development of a new platform to allow Scouts, staff and registrants to participate and sign up in Boy Scouts of America events held in many places of the country.

positions.title: Senior Python Developer
positions.description:
https://www.about.fundthis.us/

Development and support of FUND:THIS, a platform to support civil campaigns mainly used for US Senator campaigns funding.
● Developed responsive UI views in React.js for the main MVP screens
● Integrated A/B testing in React to evaluate different UI themes
● Backend development in Django (Python)
● Unit and functional testing with Pytest

Technologies: Python, Django, Pytest, React.js, Jest, Enzyme

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and building of a web application for a portfolio investments prediction model.
Tools used: Grommet.io, Node.js, React.js.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
- Development of real estate dynamic pricing maps using React.js and the Google Maps API.
- Acceptance tests to ensure the quality of the business services, using Selenium.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Kickstart of the development area of the company, leading the first tech projects using the required technologies (Ruby on Rails, Django, AWS...).

honors.title: Premio CENEVAL al Desempeño de Excelencia-EGEL
honors.description:
Excelencia en prueba a nivel nacional CENEVAL EGEL-ISOFT.
Los sustentantes acreedores a esta distinción alcanzan el nivel de desempeño sobresaliente en todas y cada una de las áreas que conforman el EGEL y representan 1.0% del total de los sustentantes a nivel nacional (98 535) del periodo julio-diciembre 2016.
honors.issuer: Issued by Secretaría de Educación Publica  · Dec 2016

projects.title: Bank App Transactions
projects.description: React 16 & Sinatra application to list bank transactions using Plaid as account provider. It connects to the Plaid service to gather bank transactions and then uses Clearbit’s Enrich API to fetch more information about the company who charged the transaction.
